name: coding-toolbox
description: Mechanically enforces the Interaction axis on Stop, blocks content operations on non-UTF-8 files with an encoding hint, runs an async npm ci when a package-lock.json project is entered via EnterWorktree (toggle: npm_ci_on_worktree), refreshes a newly-created worktree from its default branch on origin (toggle: worktree_refresh), and provides fresh-branch, fresh-pr, fresh-work, feature-development, debugging, bump-version, setup-rules and refresh-tools-rule skills — fresh-work classifies a unit of work and dispatches to debugging (fix path) or feature-development (design path, for both feature and refactor: design/plan/implement/review) before opening a PR via fresh-pr; setup-rules installs the golden behavior rules doc (Interaction/Language/Behavior/Mentality) and a tool-routing table as opt-in user-level rules (every project on this machine, also invocable non-interactively via a verbatim argument), refresh-tools-rule is its narrow, model-invocable, non-destructive companion for refreshing an already-installed tool-routing rule — for self-contained git branch, PR/MR, end-to-end work pipeline, semver version-bump and user-level rules setup management.

npm_ci_on_worktree.title: Auto npm ci on worktree entry
npm_ci_on_worktree.description: When entering a git worktree (EnterWorktree) whose project has a package-lock.json, runs npm ci there in the background. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it (deliberate exception to plugin-userconfig.md's state-creating-toggle recommendation, confirmed with the user at the design intent-confirmation gate). Default: true.

worktree_refresh.title: Worktree refresh on EnterWorktree
worktree_refresh.description: When EnterWorktree creates a new worktree (not when switching into an existing one), fetches and rebases it onto the repo's default branch on origin. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled — the worktree_refresh hook no-ops immediately, no git commands run. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it. Default: true.
